claims.claim: Paragraph (6) of 16 U.S.C. 7125(g) is the RAC pilot program sunset paragraph, struck by Section 3
claims.sourceSpan: Report to Congress Not later 180 days after the date described in paragraph (5)
claims.note: Paragraph (6) is the 'Report to Congress' requirement, NOT the sunset. The sunset is paragraph (5) ('Termination of effectiveness ... terminates on October 1, 2023'), which Section 3 EXTENDED to 2026 - it was not removed. Mislabeling the struck paragraph as the 'sunset paragraph' implies the pilot's sunset was eliminated (pilot made permanent) when it was actually extended. The removal-of-(6) fact is correct; the descriptor is wrong. Contradicts the analysis's own Section 3 item and underreported[1], which correctly identify (5) as sunset and (6) as the report requirement.

notes: Source-only hostile audit against bill-text/119-S-356.txt (enacted Public Law 119-58, 5717 chars) plus 8 registered referencedSources (16 U.S.C. 7101/7111/7112/7113/7125/7128/7142/7144, 2024 USCODE edition). One material error: changes.removed[0] mislabels the struck 16 U.S.C. 7125(g) paragraph (6) as 'the RAC pilot program sunset paragraph' - it is the 'Report to Congress' requirement; the sunset is paragraph (5), which the bill EXTENDED to 2026 (not removed). The analysis's own Section 3 item and underreported[1] describe (5)/(6) correctly, so this is an isolated changes-list descriptor error, not a systemic inversion. Minor items: 'other municipal services' (soft gloss, x2) and likelihoodReason sponsor/cosponsor structural metadata (not in bill text, but permitted per rubric class 8). All year-change amendments, section/USC cites, the 45-day Treasury deadline, double-payment offsets, added 7112 subparagraph designations, and technical corrections verified verbatim. featured_quotes not audited (CR/congressionalRecord source not in scope of source-only pass). Coverage complete: all four bill sections and every substantive provision represented; no material omission.
